passage:
Bus driver Mr. Shen knew many students who took his bus. He remembered where they usually got off and reminded them when they looked sleepy.
One rainy afternoon, a student named Alice left her science project on the bus. It was due the next morning.
Mr. Shen found it after his last route. The school was already closed, so he drove back early the next day and gave it to the guard.
Alice got the project before class. She thanked Mr. Shen with a card.
Mr. Shen said, "I only returned what was yours."
But Alice knew he had done more than that. He had cared about a student's worry after his workday should have been over.
